homePage.aboutP1: Located in the very heart of Daruvar, at T. G. Masaryk Street 1, GINKO Boutique Rooms & Wellness offers a unique blend of elegance, comfort and relaxation. The name was inspired by the oldest and most famous Ginkgo biloba tree in Europe, which has adorned the grounds of Janković Castle since the 18th century.
homePage.aboutP2: Our modern rooms and wellness apartments sit within the town’s protected historic centre, just a few minutes’ walk from Daruvar Spa and the Aquae Balissae aqua park. Thanks to this excellent location, GINKO is an ideal choice for a wellness stay, a family weekend, business travel or recovery after medical and aesthetic treatments.
homePage.aboutP3: Whether you want to enjoy a private wellness area, explore the beauty of Daruvar or find a quiet place to rest, GINKO Boutique Rooms & Wellness will give you outstanding service and a feeling of home in the town of greenery and beer.

travelerQuestions.qualityDesc: Based on guest reviews, visitors especially highlight the clean and tidy accommodation, the quiet location in central Daruvar, and the hosts' hospitality. Below are answers to the most common questions.

parking.q: Is parking secure and is there a charge?
parking.a: Yes, all our guests have free private parking right next to the property.

breakfast.a: Yes, we have a newly renovated dining area on site where we serve a fresh, hearty breakfast for our guests. Breakfast can be added when booking.

wifi.a: Yes, free Wi-Fi is available in all rooms and common areas.

therms.q: How far are the Daruvar thermal baths?
therms.a: The Daruvar thermal baths are within a few minutes' walk of the property.

attractions.a: Nearby you'll find Janković Castle park, Daruvar thermal baths, the Church of the Holy Trinity and the city centre.

pets.a: Yes, pets are welcome with prior notice when booking. The pet cleaning fee is €15 / day.

checkin.q: How does check-in work if we arrive late?
checkin.a: Our check-in process is very flexible. Before arrival you will receive clear instructions for self check-in and key or code collection, and the hosts are always available for quick communication.

checkinTimes.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
checkinTimes.a: Check-in is from 14:00 to 22:00, and check-out is by 10:00.

wellness.q: Does the property have wellness (sauna, jacuzzi)?
wellness.a: Yes. Access to the wellness area with sauna and jacuzzi is exclusively for guests who book the wellness apartment.

families.a: Yes, some rooms accommodate up to 4 guests and are suitable for families.

booking.q: How can I book a room?
booking.a: You can submit a booking request via our <bookingLink>booking form</bookingLink> or contact us by email and phone.

cancellation.a: Free cancellation and deposit refund up to 14 days before arrival. For cancellations within 14 days of arrival, the deposit is non-refundable.

privacyPage.description: Privacy policy of Ginko Boutique Rooms & Wellness — how we collect, use and protect your personal data in line with the GDPR.

privacyPage.controllerBody: The data controller is {legalName}, OIB {oib}, {address}. For privacy questions you can contact us by email: <email></email>.
privacyPage.dataIntro: We collect the following categories of personal data:
privacyPage.dataBookingText: name, email, phone number, stay dates, number of guests.
privacyPage.dataCommsText: messages you send us via the contact form or email.
privacyPage.dataTechText: IP address, browser type, cookies (only with your consent).
privacyPage.retentionBody: Booking data is kept for 7 years in line with accounting obligations. Communication data is deleted after 2 years. Analytics data (with consent) is kept until consent is withdrawn.
privacyPage.rightsIntro: Under the GDPR you have the right to:
privacyPage.rightsRequest: You can submit a request at <email></email>. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with <azop>AZOP</azop> (the Croatian data protection authority).
privacyPage.cookiesBody: We use essential cookies for the site to work (localisation). We use analytics cookies only with your consent. Details are in our <cookies>Cookie Policy</cookies>.
privacyPage.changesBody: This policy may be updated from time to time. The last-updated date is always shown at the top of the page.

cookiesPage.title: Cookie Policy
cookiesPage.description: Cookie policy of Ginko Boutique Rooms & Wellness — which cookies we use and how to manage your settings.

openGraph.title: Cookie Policy – Ginko Boutique Rooms & Wellness
openGraph.description: Which cookies we use and how to manage your settings.
openGraph.imageAlt: Ginko Boutique Rooms & Wellness – cookie policy

cookiesPage.whatBody: Cookies are small text files that websites store in your browser. They are used to remember your settings and to analyse how the site is used.
cookiesPage.necessaryBody: The language cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) remembers your selected language and is required for the site to display correctly. It does not require consent.
cookiesPage.analyticsBody: We use analytics cookies only if you accept them. We collect anonymous visit data (pages viewed, visit duration) to improve the experience. No personal data is included.
cookiesPage.consentBody: The ginko_cookie_consent cookie stores your choice (accepted/declined) so we do not ask again on every visit.
cookiesPage.manageBody: You can decline or withdraw analytics at any time via the banner shown on your first visit. You can also delete cookies directly in your browser settings.
cookiesPage.thirdBody: Photos are served from our domain. Typography is loaded via next/font (self-hosted after the build). If you accept analytics and Google Analytics (GA4) is configured, Google may set analytics cookies — see their privacy policy.

cookieBanner.body: We use analytics cookies to improve your experience. You can accept or decline optional cookies.
